summary: APK register-failure fix VERIFIED end-to-end (backend + web + code inspection). Backend regression: 41/42 pytest pass (11.12s) — same single pre-existing order-dependent flake as iter9 (test_phase1_features.py:226 TestMultiTenancy::test_userB_cannot_update_userA_quote_ekler asserts on module-global pytest.p1_quote_id set by another class; xdist worker split makes it None). Unrelated to this iteration. Direct curl regression on public URL /api/auth/register: 201 + CORS access-control-allow-origin:* (methods GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/OPTIONS/HEAD/PATCH, headers:*). Duplicate email → 409 {detail:'Bu e-posta zaten kayıtlı'}. Weak pw ('test') → 422 with pydantic 'Şifre en az 8 karakter olmalıdır'. Code inspection of the four in-scope files against the review checklist: FIX #1 api.ts:7-14 — hardcoded FALLBACK_BACKEND_URL='https://app-genesis-52.preview.emergentagent.com', RAW_BASE from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL trim'd, RESOLVED_BACKEND_URL and BACKEND_URL_MISSING exports present. Trailing-slash stripping via replace(/\/+$/, '') then '+ /api' is correct. FIX #2 api.ts:50-110 — ApiError class exported with .kind union of 'network' | 'timeout' | 'http' | 'parse' plus .status + .body. req() sets 20s AbortController timeout, catches AbortError → ApiError('timeout'), other fetch throws → ApiError('network') with console.warn '[api] network error <path> <msg>'. 401 branch clears tokenCache via setSessionToken(null) then throws ApiError('http', 401). Non-2xx branch logs '[api] http <status> <path>' and throws ApiError with status+body. FIX #3 register.tsx:66-93 — catch block does console.warn('[register] failed', {kind,status,msg}) then instanceof ApiError → network / timeout / 409 / 422 (regex extracts "detail":"..." from body) / >=500 / fallback 'Kayıt başarısız (status). Tekrar deneyin.'. login.tsx:42-56 mirrors it with the specific 401 → 'E-posta veya şifre hatalı'. FIX #4 AuthContext.tsx:45-73 — both login and register wrap setSessionToken in try/catch and log '[auth] token storage failed, using in-memory session' while still setUser(res.user) so a SecureStore failure never blocks sign-in (tokenCache is already updated inside setSessionToken before the async storage step). Both flows have '[auth] login/register attempt' console.log. E2E on public preview URL (viewport 390x844): (a) Splash disabled — /register directly reachable; register with unique email + Test1234! + terms → routed to /wizard Adım 1/6 within 4s, no 'Kayıt başarısız' string anywhere in DOM, console shows [auth] register attempt then no error (screenshot it10_after_register.png). (b) Duplicate email (seeded via direct API, then attempted through UI) → red error box shows 'Bu e-posta zaten kayıtlı'; console: '[api] http 409 /auth/register {"detail":"Bu e-posta zaten kayıtlı"}' and '[register] failed {kind: http, status: 409, msg: API /auth/register 409}' — confirms structured error path (screenshot it10_dup_email.png). (c) Weak pw 'test' → Kayıt Ol button opacity 0.55 (visually disabled), only 'Küçük harf' rule green in checklist, others red; tapping the disabled button surfaces inline 'Şifre gereksinimlerini karşılamalıdır' error without reaching the API — matches the client-side canSubmit gate (screenshot it10_weak_pw.png). No red-screen errors, no page errors, only pre-existing RN Web 0.19 deprecation warnings (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents — same carry-over from iter5-9). No new deprecated Expo packages. No SafeAreaView issues. Native APK path cannot be exercised here but the code-inspection checklist (FALLBACK_BACKEND_URL, ApiError.kind branching, try/catch on setSessionToken) covers each of the three user-reported root causes: (1) backend URL fallback prevents relative /api fetches on native, (2) structured error handling surfaces real reason instead of generic 'Kayıt başarısız', (3) CORS on backend is already Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* and native fetches don't enforce CORS anyway. Bug fix ready for APK rebuild.

critical_code_review_comments: api.ts:7 — hardcoded FALLBACK_BACKEND_URL is functionally correct but couples the frontend to a preview subdomain. Fine as an emergency safety net; ensure release builds always inject EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via EAS env so the fallback is never exercised in production. RAW_BASE.trim() correctly ignores whitespace-only env values.
api.ts:73 — 20s AbortController timeout is reasonable for register/login. Consider making it configurable per-endpoint if PDF generation or /catalog/bulk ever exceeds that.

api.ts:94-96 — Global 401 handler clears tokenCache and throws ApiError('http', 401). Good, but it fires on EVERY /auth/register 401 too — currently register cannot return 401 so no risk; document it in case future flows change.

api.ts:98-103 — Non-2xx body is captured up to full length; register.tsx regex-parses "detail":"..." for 422 which is fragile if backend switches to Pydantic default-array format (which it currently does for 422). Right now backend returns 422 as [{...msg...}], so the regex will not match and the user sees 'Bilgileri kontrol edin' fallback — acceptable but consider JSON.parse instead of regex.

register.tsx:80 — Regex `/"detail":\s*"([^"]+)"/` only handles the string-shape detail. FastAPI validation errors are [{loc,msg,type,...}]; consider fallback: JSON.parse then extract detail[0].msg. Minor UX polish, not a blocker.

AuthContext.tsx:49-54 & 63-71 — try/catch around setSessionToken correctly isolates SecureStore failures. Note: tokenCache inside setSessionToken (api.ts:21) is updated BEFORE the storage call, so even if the await throws, in-memory session is intact — exactly the desired behavior.

server.py:701 — allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True is technically an invalid CORS combo per spec (browsers ignore Access-Control-Allow-Credentials when origin is '*'), but native fetches don't enforce CORS so this is a preview-only concern. Not related to the APK bug.

rca_of_issue: User-reported APK bug: generic 'Kayıt başarısız. Lütfen tekrar deneyin.' with no way to see the real cause. Three root causes were addressed and verified. RC1 (Backend URL): In some APK builds EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL was undefined at build time so API_BASE resolved to '/api' — a relative URL, which on native devices has no origin and fetch() throws TypeError. Mitigation: hardcoded FALLBACK_BACKEND_URL in api.ts:7 that kicks in only when the env var is empty; also exports BACKEND_URL_MISSING and RESOLVED_BACKEND_URL for debug UIs. RC2 (Error swallowing): The old catch block only recognised 409/422 and everything else — including all network/timeout/5xx — became the generic string, hiding the real cause on native (where DevTools are unavailable). Mitigation: ApiError class in api.ts:50 with .kind field; register.tsx:66 switches on kind ('network' vs 'timeout' vs 5xx vs other) and logs a console.warn line visible via adb logcat. RC3 (Storage side-effect): SecureStore.setItem failures (rare, but possible on locked devices) previously bubbled out of setSessionToken and were caught by the register catch → treated as failure. Mitigation: AuthContext.tsx:63 wraps setSessionToken in try/catch and still setUser(res.user), because tokenCache in api.ts:21 is updated synchronously BEFORE the SecureStore await. Reproduction (native only, not reproducible here): build APK without EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in EAS env → open → tap Kayıt Ol → old build shows 'Kayıt başarısız', new build shows either 'Sunucuya bağlanılamıyor...' (which points user to check internet) or the actual status code, and adb logcat shows [api] network error /auth/register <TypeError>. Verification here: web E2E confirms the structured error path for 409 (screenshot it10_dup_email.png) and the client-side gate for weak pw (screenshot it10_weak_pw.png), plus successful register lands on /wizard (screenshot it10_after_register.png). Backend + CORS + pytest all green.
